featuredSeason.title: OG REDDIT TRADING TERMS
featuredSeason.quote: THE INTERNET TAUGHT THE MARKET HOW TO SPEAK.
featuredSeason.summary: Loop travels through the language and legends that shaped Reddit trading culture — one short episode at a time.
featuredSeason.coverIntro: Before the trenches had a name, the internet was already inventing its language. Start with Stonks, then meet the Apes.
featuredSeason.shareText: Loop Gaiden Season 01 — OG Reddit Trading Terms is live.

scenes.title: STONKS.
scenes.body: Loop discovers an ancient law of retail trading: Number goes up. Confidence goes up faster. No DD. Just a green chart, too much caffeine, and one word that explained everything: STONKS. One winning trade — and suddenly you're a genius. 😂
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop investigates Stonks, luck and overconfidence in early retail trading culture

scenes.title: APES TOGETHER STRONG.
scenes.body: Loop discovers the Ape: no fancy terminal, no hedge fund, and one remarkable ability — refusing to sell. Then he finds another. And another. Different people. Same stock. Same red chart. Apes together strong. 🦍∞
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers how retail traders became stronger together by refusing to sell

scenes.title: ALTSEASON.
scenes.body: Loop discovers Altseason. Bitcoin barely moves while everything else loses its mind. Frogs pump. Dogs pump. Even bananas pump. Nobody asks why. Bitcoin is resting. The alts are partying. 🚀∞
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers Altseason while Bitcoin rests and the alts rally

scenes.title: BUTTCOIN.
scenes.body: Loop discovers another tribe from the early trenches: the skeptics. Bitcoin believers saw the future of money. The skeptics watched every pump with the same suspicion. Markets moved. Prices changed. Their verdict didn't. To them, Bitcoin had another name: Buttcoin.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers the Bitcoin skeptics and their name for it, Buttcoin

activeIssue.title: THE FARMER
activeIssue.summary: Opened from the active comic file. New scenes can be unlocked here as they drop on X.
activeIssue.coverIntro: Start with the cover, then enter the transmission scene by scene.

scenes.title: THE TRENCHES.
scenes.body: Farmers. Rugs. Insiders. Everyone wanted a piece of the trenches. Loop watches a system built on taking.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop watches a system built on taking from the trenches

scenes.title: FARMER CAPITAL.
scenes.body: What looked like chaos had become a business. Above the trenches, Farmer Capital turned extraction into an industry.
scenes.ariaLabel: Farmer Capital turns extraction into an industry

scenes.title: INFILTRATION.
scenes.body: Loop slips inside Farmer Capital, searching for what the polished walls were designed to hide.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop infiltrates Farmer Capital

scenes.title: THE OPERATION.
scenes.body: Behind closed doors, Loop discovers the machinery behind the farming - communities, liquidity, hype and extraction.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers the machinery behind the farming operation

scenes.title: PRIVATE RESERVES.
scenes.body: Loop follows the trail deeper and discovers where everything taken from the trenches ultimately ends up.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers Farmer Capital's private reserves

scenes.title: THE FARMER.
scenes.body: At the top of the operation, Loop finally finds the one behind it all - The Farmer. Watching. Profiting. Always wanting more. ∞
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop finds The Farmer at the top of the operation

scenes.title: THE FARMER KNEW.
scenes.body: Loop's investigation was never a secret. The Farmer has been watching him - and waiting.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Farmer reveals that he has been watching Loop

scenes.title: THE CYCLE.
scenes.body: The Farmer reveals the machine behind the harvest: launch, hype, community, liquidity, harvest... repeat.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Farmer reveals the cycle behind the harvest

scenes.title: THE EXPOSURE.
scenes.body: Loop doesn't destroy the operation. He exposes it - the wallets, the patterns and the cycle for everyone in the trenches to see.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop exposes the Farmer's wallets, patterns and cycle

scenes.title: YOU RUINED ME.
scenes.body: The truth spreads through the trenches. Markets collapse, communities turn, and the Farmer watches his empire unravel.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Farmer watches his empire unravel

scenes.title: YOU CAN'T KILL GREED.
scenes.body: The Farmer warns Loop that another will always take his chair. Loop already knows. Greed can't be killed - but it can always be exposed.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Farmer warns Loop that greed cannot be killed

scenes.title: THE TRENCHES DECIDE.
scenes.body: With the Farmer exposed and his guards defeated, Loop rides back into the trenches. What happens next is no longer his decision. The trenches decide. ∞
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop rides back into the trenches after exposing The Farmer

nextIssue.title: THE CROWN
nextIssue.summary: The Crown turns wealth, followers and attention into influence — until Loop exposes what the audience never sees.
nextIssue.coverIntro: The Crown does not hide his greed. Enter the next transmission scene by scene.
nextIssue.shareText: Season 01, Story 02: The Crown is live.

scenes.title: LOOK AT ME.
scenes.body: The Crown doesn't hide his greed. He puts it on display. Wealth, followers, luxury and attention have made him one of the most visible figures in the trenches.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Crown displays his wealth, followers, luxury and influence

scenes.title: THE PROMISE.
scenes.body: The Crown sells more than coins. He sells dreams of wealth, freedom and belonging - and millions are watching.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Crown promises wealth, freedom and belonging to millions of viewers

scenes.title: THE FOLLOWERS.
scenes.body: Every post brings likes, comments and new followers. The bigger The Crown becomes, the more people assume he must be right.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Crown gains likes, comments and new followers with every post

scenes.title: BEHIND THE CAMERA.
scenes.body: Loop looks beyond the image and discovers what the audience never sees - paid promotion, coordinated engagement and carefully manufactured influence.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers the paid promotion and coordinated engagement behind The Crown

scenes.title: THE LOSERS.
scenes.body: The Crown celebrates the winners while the failures disappear from view. Behind every success story are people the feed conveniently forgot.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Crown celebrates winners while failures disappear from view

scenes.title: CAUGHT ON CAMERA.
scenes.body: Loop finally catches The Crown's operation in action. The perfect public image begins to crack as the machinery behind the influence is exposed.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop catches The Crown's operation in action

scenes.title: WHO DO YOU BELIEVE?
scenes.body: The Crown built his power on a simple idea: if enough people follow you, others stop asking whether you are right.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Crown uses follower count to make people trust him

scenes.title: HALL OF MIRRORS.
scenes.body: Loop enters the world behind The Crown's image - a hall of selective wins, hidden failures, paid promotions and manufactured success.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop enters the hall of mirrors behind The Crown's image

scenes.title: THE COMPLETE RECORD.
scenes.body: Loop exposes what The Crown left out. The audience finally sees the wins, the losses and the manipulation together - not just the version they were sold.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop reveals the complete record behind The Crown's image

scenes.title: NOBODY'S WATCHING.
scenes.body: The illusion collapses when the attention disappears. Without the audience, the status and the spectacle, The Crown is just another frog in a chair.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Crown sits alone after the audience and spectacle disappear

openIssues.title: THE MANIPULATOR
openIssues.summary: Loop follows a manufactured signal through KOLs, bots, FOMO and media until every trail leads to the same source.
openIssues.coverIntro: The trail led higher. Someone had been watching everything.
openIssues.shareText: Issue 003: The Manipulator file is opening.

scenes.title: THE WATCHER.
scenes.body: The trail led higher. And someone had been watching everything.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Watcher follows Loop from above

scenes.title: THE NARRATIVE.
scenes.body: He did not follow the hype. He controlled it.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Manipulator controls the narrative

scenes.title: THE WISE ONE.
scenes.body: Some enemies cannot be defeated with a sword. An old friend from the trenches shows Loop the Manipulator's true weapon: control the hype, control the minds.
scenes.ariaLabel: The Wise One shows Loop the Manipulator's true weapon

scenes.title: THE WAY FORWARD.
scenes.body: Unipcs points him toward the heart of the manipulation: Times Square.
scenes.ariaLabel: Unipcs points Loop toward Times Square

scenes.title: THE STRINGS.
scenes.body: Everyone saw the hype. Loop saw who was pulling the strings.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop sees who is pulling the strings behind the hype

scenes.title: THE CONFRONTATION.
scenes.body: Loop came ready to fight. The Manipulator turned the trenches against him.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop confronts The Manipulator as the trenches turn against him

scenes.title: THE SAME SOURCE.
scenes.body: Loop follows the manipulation through KOLs, bots, FOMO and media - and discovers every signal leads back to the same source.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop follows manipulated signals back to the same source

scenes.title: THE BIG GUNS.
scenes.body: Loop found the source. But some battles are too big to fight alone. He called Meow - and together they took the Manipulator's broadcast network offline.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop and Meow take the Manipulator's broadcast network offline

scenes.title: THE TRUTH.
scenes.body: The signal was gone. The strings were broken. For the first time, nobody was telling the trenches what to believe. They could finally see the truth for themselves.
scenes.ariaLabel: The trenches finally see the truth for themselves
